projects.title: Tuberculosis Visualization
projects.description: Interactive visualization of tuberculosis prevalence data across different regions and time periods

projects.title: Construction Document RAG Pipeline
projects.description: Flask-based RAG demo over 2023 Florida Residential Building Code markdown chapters with LangChain and OpenAI.
projects.summary: A retrieval-augmented generation pipeline that answers questions about the 2023 Florida Residential Building Code using Docling-converted markdown chapters, OpenAI embeddings, and a Flask web interface hosted on Render.
projects.challenge: Building a useful code assistant from PDF-derived markdown where tables and figures do not always convert cleanly, while keeping deployment costs off the portfolio owner via bring-your-own-key inference.
projects.solution: Converted code chapters to markdown with Docling, chunked by headers for retrieval, and deployed a Flask app that embeds in the portfolio. Visitors supply their own OpenAI API key for embeddings and generation.
results: End-to-end RAG flow: chunk → embed → retrieve → generate
46 residential code chapters indexed for retrieval
Live demo embedded in portfolio via Render
